Agenda
Item 1
Sustainability Report 1993 — Draft Review

The {item_title} was a review of the company's compliance with patent laws. The committee reviewed the company's patent portfolio and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 2
Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review

The Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review was a review of the company's compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA). The committee reviewed the company's safety record and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 3
Shareholder Engagement Strategy — Proxy Season 1993

The committee considered the Shareholder Engagement Strategy — Proxy Season 1993, a proposal to adopt a new policy on trade secrets. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Item 4
Government Affairs Update — 10 Legislation

The Government Affairs Update — 10 Legislation was a review of the company's compliance with contract laws. The committee reviewed the company's contracting process and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 5
Current Report on Form 8-K — Recent Filings

The committee considered the Current Report on Form 8-K — Recent Filings, a proposal to adopt a new policy on trade secrets. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for KPIs: RESOLVED, that the Data Analytics Governance Board approves the 1993 annual report on Form 10-K for filing with the SEC.

Moved: Mekdes Salinas  •  Seconded: Marek Cooke
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
